scope.each: one local profile of prepare plus first five serial operations from an 800-entry bound plan; no whole-run/SLO/PAC acceptance
scope.inputs: Parent-confirmed full plan/ref/request/guardrail runtime matched; each version used its corresponding normal seed and frozen source. v10 and v11 seed DB hashes differ as expected for source versions.
scope.source_change: Parent-confirmed product source delta is run_evidence digest-only binding cache plus authority lock. Each profile result reports source and seed unchanged during its own run, 5 operations/7 attempts, 0 terminal receipts, no finalize, cleanup confirmed.

interpretation.copy_measure: Used the raw pstats copy.deepcopy function row above. The profile_summary deepcopy category is excluded because category totals overlap and double-count nested cumulative time/calls.
interpretation.cache_warming: The v10 path for all 45 bound_bundle_digest calls entered _bound and therefore the full-bound cache; v11 calls the digest-only cache instead. Cache keys include decorated function identity, so digest-only entries cannot satisfy/warm _cached_bound. The profile has four digest-cache miss body calls and three later/full-bound _validate_store_contents misses, versus four full-bound miss body calls total in v10. This is consistent with lost cross-path warming adding three uncached binds (~0.623s cumulative in this profile), although pstats does not expose exact input-key equality/hit/eviction data.
interpretation.workload_shift: v11 saves about 1.276s of _pack cumulative work on the 45 digest calls and reduces bound_bundle_digest cumulative by about 1.476s, while _bound_uncached cumulative rises by about 0.623s and raw deepcopy by 0.434s. Five-op wall decreases only 0.220780335s (about 0.81%). This is a modest net win in one matched pair, not proof of general improvement.

shared_cache.evidence: src/gah/run_evidence.py imports the process-global binding_cache for both _cached_bound and _cached_bound_digest. src/gah/immutable_cache.py defines one 16 MiB/32-entry JsonCache; keys include the decorated function object, and all entries share one LRU byte/entry budget.
shared_cache.competition: Digest-only and full-bound keys compete with each other and other binding_cache users. Its digest value is small, but its key retains the complete payload; no cache_info/hit/eviction counters are in these profiles, so actual eviction/pressure cannot be asserted.

decision.recommendation: Keep the digest-only implementation provisionally; do not revert based only on the raw deepcopy increase. Its explicit purpose—avoid serializing/copying/packing a full rebound tree for digest callers—shows in lower _pack/bound digest cumulative cost, and the matched five-op wall is slightly lower.
decision.acceptance: Hold any performance acceptance claim. A single pair has only 0.81% wall difference and no hit/miss/eviction evidence; treat result as diagnostic and acknowledge the +230,518 raw deepcopy calls.
decision.one_followup_candidate: If a later bounded comparison shows the three _validate_store_contents full-bound misses have the same complete payloads as the four digest-cache misses, consider a narrowly scoped shared per-key immutable binding record carrying both digest and encoded bound, but only if its full retained value is charged to the existing 16 MiB/32-entry shared budget and mutable public return isolation remains. Otherwise keep the current separate modes; do not add a second cache or increase limits.

not_done: No additional profile/test/source execution or edits.
